notes: E2E ciphertext only, gapless seq, TTL purge, opt-in receipts, delete-for-me. Sender attribution is relay-asserted; no server-side retention for threads with no active member.
2..20 participants, invite+accept, leave/re-invite, per-participant archive/mute, block checks. Subject binding is by id prefix; existence of the subject is not verified (no port).
Metadata, 10MB cap, mime allowlist, 24h pending expiry; JPEG/PNG strippers fuzzed. Blob upload/storage is relay-side; WebP and PDF metadata stripping not implemented.
Cards reference offer/proposal/cycle by id + revisionHash; new revision supersedes. Existence and hash of the referenced record are not verified (owner ports not in kernel).
Signed per-revision consent (context 'consent'), key checked against identity, append-only, verifyConsent/hasAllConsent for other features. Signature is evidence of assertion only.
Moderator-curated public spots (name, kind, regionCell<=5), public list, safety tips. No address or coordinates stored; names are free text curated by moderators.
Check-in claims, hashed 6-digit receiver code with 5-attempt lock and expiry, bilateral evidence event, trusted-contact token (window + safe-spot name only). Not proof of delivery.
Propose/accept/counter/reschedule/cancel with per-revision consent, encrypted private place, expiry sweeper, no-show claims flagged when contradicted by check-in.
